BarValueAxis.label: Bar value axis

prose.summary:
The VALUE axis of a horizontal `BarChart` — tick values along the bottom (or top) of the plot.

A horizontal bar chart usually needs none: its bars carry value labels. A range plot drawn with `overlays`, or a chart whose bars are too many to label, has nothing else to read a length against — that is what this is for. It reads the chart's own value scale, so its ticks sit exactly on `<Grid vertical />`'s lines. A no-op in a vertical chart (use `YAxis` there).

prose.summary:
`NetworkChart` — a node-link graph in three layouts (RM-036).

Token-driven, theme-safe, deterministic and keyboard-operable. See the module header for the three decisions that shape it: the force layout is SOLVED, not animated; the keyboard path lives outside the `aria-hidden` SVG; adjacency emphasis is a CSS class driven by one piece of state.

The container follows the package's `role="figure"` a11y convention (`chart-a11y.tsx`) rather than a bare `role="img"`, so a reader can still reach the datapoint targets inside it; the summary string RM-036 asks for (`"Network, 60 nodes, 140 links, 5 groups"`) is the default accessible name.

prose.summary:
`TreemapChart` — a two-level squarified treemap (RM-025). Area encodes value straight from the `d3-hierarchy` layout (no sqrt); the default `palette: "mono"` gives every leaf one shade, so groups are separated by their title band + paper gap alone, never by colour.

Token-driven, theme-safe, keyboard-operable: leaves register as `ChartDatapointLayer` targets when `onDatapointClick`/`copyValueOnActivate` is set (the shared cross-family interaction contract, #349); the optional `drilldown` zoom is a SEPARATE, real-`<button>` affordance on each group's title band, so a static chart never gains a click handler beyond `onDatapointClick`.

UnitChart.description: A total as discrete, countable units — a waffle, a field or tally rows.

accessibleDescription.description: Accessible description read after the name.

accessibleLabel.description: Accessible name, when the visible title is missing or not enough.

className.description: Extra class names on the chart root.

copyValueOnActivate.description: Copy a datapoint’s exact value to the clipboard when it is activated.

data.description: Series: one label and value per row.

dimExcluded.description: Dim the marks a selection excludes.

maxInteractiveDatapoints.description: Number of keyboard targets above which a development warning is logged.

palette.description: Colour family. Past 6 series, an unset palette degrades to neutral.

showArithmetic.description: Show the footer arithmetic. Ignored by rows.

sort.description: Sort series by value, descending, before laying out.

total.description: What 100% of the marks represents. Ignored by rows.

unit.description: Value per mark — a unit of 2 draws one mark per two incidents.

unitLabel.description: “one dot = one person in a hundred” style caption.

UnitChart.label: Unit chart

prose.avoidWhen: exact per-unit counts do not matter — a pie or bar chart reads faster
dataShapes: parts of a whole as discrete unit counts rather than a percentage, as layout="waffle"
one tally row per category, ticks summing to a total — ticket volume by weekday, for example, as layout="rows"
prose.summary: `UnitChart` — draws `layout="waffle" | "field" | "rows"`. When `onDatapointClick`/`copyValueOnActivate` is set the body is wrapped in a `ChartDatapointProvider` so its series can register keyboard targets — the provider has to sit ABOVE the component that registers (#349).

WaterfallChart.description: How a starting total becomes an ending total, one signed step at a time.

accessibleDescription.description: Accessible description read after the name.

accessibleLabel.description: Accessible name, when the visible title is missing or not enough.

analytics.description: Statistical overlays computed from the data: lines, bands, trends and more.

annotations.description: Notes, ranges and reference lines in data units, in reading order.

callouts.description: The steps that explain the bridge, named on the chart with a note.

className.description: Extra class names on the chart root.

connectors.description: Hairline from each step’s end to the next step’s start: none, thin or thick.

copyValueOnActivate.description: Copy a datapoint’s exact value to the clipboard when it is activated.

data.description: Steps from the first total to the last: one row per bar.

dataFormat.description: Whether each row’s value is a signed change or the running total.

end.description: Show or relabel the last column.

height.description: Height of the plot in pixels. Use plotHeight.

labels.description: Which rows carry a value label, and how the differences read.

margin.description: Space around the plot, in pixels: one number for every side, or per side.

maxInteractiveDatapoints.description: Number of keyboard targets above which a development warning is logged.

plotHeight.description: Height of the plot: pixels, or { aspect } as width divided by height. Set { base, medium, narrow } to vary it by breakpoint.

showValues.description: Print the signed value on each step.

sort.description: Order of the steps within each subtotal group.

start.description: Show or relabel the first column.

status.description: Show the loading skeleton until the data is ready.

subtotalBy.description: Insert a subtotal after each run of rows sharing this field’s value.

subtotalLabel.description: Label of an inserted subtotal: a template with {group}. Needs subtotalBy.

unit.description: Draw each bar as a stack of rungs, one per this much value.

valueFormat.description: How values are printed: a preset, or a spec for decimals, sign, prefix and suffix.

zoomToDifferences.description: Drop the zero baseline when the totals dwarf the steps.

WaterfallChart.label: Waterfall chart

prose.avoidWhen: there is no meaningful running total — use diverging bars instead

dateFormat.description: Date label preset. Unset: picked from the span on screen.

domain.description: Numeric x only: pin either end of the domain, or auto.

numTicks.description: Exact tick count; wins over tickCount.

orientation.description: Edge the tick labels sit on.

periodTicks.description: A hairline tick per calendar period below the plot.

scale.description: Numeric x only: how values map to pixels.

tickCount.description: How many ticks the axis aims for, or auto to fit the plot size.

tickMode.description: Ticks spread evenly across the domain, or one per data row.

tickerHalfWidth.description: Half width of the date ticker box, for the edge fade.

ticks.description: Exactly these tick positions on a numeric x axis.

titlePlacement.description: Title in the margin (outside) or inside the plot.

YAxis.description: The value axis beside a cartesian chart's plot, on the left or the right.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for currency values.

domain.description: Pin either end of the value domain, or auto.

labelPlacement.description: Tick labels in the margin (outside) or above their grid lines.

matchSeriesColor.description: Colour the labels like the axis' one series.

numTicks.description: Tick count hint; wins over tickCount.

orientation.description: Side of the plot the tick labels sit on.

sideLabel.description: Caption naming the scale above the ticks, or auto.

tickCount.description: How many ticks the axis aims for, or auto to fit the plot size.

titlePlacement.description: Title in the margin (outside) or inside the plot.

unit.description: Unit text appended to the tick(s) unitOn names.

valueFormat.description: How values are printed: a preset, or a spec for decimals, sign, prefix and suffix.

yAxisId.description: Value axis this belongs to, when the chart has several.
